title: %coerceBoolean - convert a value to a boolean
purpose: Coerce truthy/falsy text or numbers to a typed boolean.
notes: Truthy strings are "true", "yes", "y", and "1" (case-insensitive); everything else is ?false.
Numbers coerce by zero/non-zero, so 0 is ?false and any other number is ?true.

avoid.why: any string outside the truthy set silently becomes ?false, not an error
